data.design: An ordinary sealed envelope with Irena’s address. No hidden mark or supernatural seal is established; the item uses a stock mail icon.

description: A sealed envelope from Irena’s daughter inland, entrusted by Jory for delivery by hand. Its contents offer Irena a painted room and a possible move. The player delivers it unopened; Irena reads the address twice before opening it herself. The letter leaves the bag on delivery, while Irena’s later words preserve its effect.

data.description: Holds the letter until the protagonist accepts delivery and can carry it.
Addressed to her by her daughter.

name: Sealed Letter
